title: The Missing Memory
summary: Fighting inside the temporal field, Kuro's true demonic memories awaken as Ha-Jun faces Queen Lilith's psychic illusions, discovering the hidden truth of the night his family was targeted.

panels.shot: temple terrace duel wide shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands between Demon Lord Valac and Queen Lilith on a massive clock dial made of white crystal.

panels.shot: valac swinging shadow scythe at ha-jun neck
panels.action: Valac sweeps an eight-foot scythe of solid living darkness in a horizontal beheading arc.

panels.shot: ha-jun parrying scythe with eclipse devourer
panels.action: Ha-Jun parries the shadow blade with Eclipse Devourer; the dark matter sword eats Valac's shadow mana.

panels.shot: queen lilith casting psychic void spell
panels.action: Queen Lilith raises both slender hands, firing an undulating beam of pink-violet psychic energy at Ha-Jun's brow.

panels.shot: ha-jun staggering back as psychic wave hits
panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches his temples as intense hallucinations flood his neural pathways.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh physical attack nahi hai... Yeh mere dimaag ki memories ko unlock kar rahi hai!

panels.shot: memory flashback: rainy night 10 years ago
panels.action: A stormy night in Seoul ten years ago; sirens wailing outside a burning suburban house.

panels.shot: 7yo ha-jun hiding inside a wooden closet
panels.action: A tiny 7yo Ha-Jun crying quietly with hands over his mouth, peering through the louvered wooden slats.

panels.shot: queen lilith standing in the living room holding a bloody blade
panels.action: Queen Lilith in human disguise standing over his fallen parents, her eyes glowing violet.

dialogue.text: Hamare parents ko kisi demon attack ne nahi mara tha... Lilith ne mara tha!

panels.shot: kuro in tiny crow form swooping in to peck lilith eyes
panels.action: A tiny Kuro diving into the room, raking his talons across Lilith's face to buy time for Tae-Jun.

panels.shot: kuro casting memory seal over 7yo ha-jun
panels.action: Kuro touching baby Ha-Jun's forehead with a purple feather, crying: 'Forget this pain, little one. Grow up safe.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh dard abhi mat saho... Bada hone tak ise bhool jao.

panels.shot: ha-jun returning to reality with tears of molten fury
panels.action: The memory ends; Ha-Jun's tears vaporize instantly into roaring violet hellfire on his cheeks.

panels.shot: queen lilith smiling with sadistic elegance
panels.action: Lilith licks her blood-red lips: 'Yes, child! I cut your mother's throat myself! And now I will finish the job!'

dialogue.speaker: lilith
dialogue.text: Tumhare parents bohot cheekh rahe the tumhare liye!

panels.shot: ha-jun sovereign crest turning deep black-crimson
panels.action: The lotus crest on Ha-Jun's chest burns through his shirt, turning into an ominous eclipse brand.

dialogue.text:
[SOVEREIGN WRATH OVERCLOCK ACTIVE]
All Relic Outputs increased by +300%.
Emotional Restraints: DISABLED.

panels.shot: ha-jun vanishing faster than light
panels.action: Ha-Jun disappears from sight, leaving an acoustic shockwave that shatters the crystal clock floor.

panels.shot: ha-jun reappearing inches from lilith face
panels.action: Ha-Jun appears point-blank before Lilith; his left bone gauntlet clamps around her throat like a hydraulic vise.

panels.shot: lilith choking with bulging eyes
panels.action: Lilith's manic smile vanishes instantly into pure, choking biological panic as her windpipe cracks.

panels.shot: ha-jun lifting lilith 10 feet into the air with one hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun hoists the 500-pound demon queen into the air by her neck with effortless one-armed power.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne meri maa ko maara... Aaj unka beta tumhe hisaab dega.

panels.shot: valac lunging from behind with shadow scythe
panels.action: Lord Valac dives at Ha-Jun's exposed back, thrusting the shadow scythe at his spine.

panels.shot: chains of ruin whipping automatically to intercept
panels.action: Without Ha-Jun even looking, the Chains of Ruin coil backward like living serpents, wrapping around Valac's scythe.

panels.shot: gravity field crushing valac scythe to powder
panels.action: The chains crush Valac's eight-foot shadow weapon into harmless black dust with 50x gravitational force.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the fang of abyss with right hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the spatial void dagger from his hip, pointing it at Lilith's forehead.

panels.shot: driving the spatial dagger through lilith core
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges the Fang of Abyss directly through Lilith's heart, severing her soul from space.

panels.shot: queen lilith body shattering like dark glass
panels.action: Lilith shrieks in agony as her physical form shatters into ten thousand dark glass fragments.

panels.shot: lilith soul sucked into the eclipse devourer
panels.action: The dark matter greatsword absorbs Lilith's entire ancestral soul, digesting her essence completely.

panels.shot: valac stumbling back in unmitigated terror
panels.action: Lord Valac drops to his knees on the broken clock dial, trembling like an autumn leaf.

dialogue.speaker: valac
dialogue.text: Lilith is dead... She was eradicated in seconds! He is not a boy... He is the Devil himself!

panels.shot: ha-jun turning cold eyes onto valac
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, the void dagger dripping dark purple starlight: 'Throne par baithne ka shauq tha na?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hourglass ka control release karo. Now.

panels.shot: valac frantically releasing the hourglass spell
panels.action: Valac frantically waves his hands; the reverse time spell dissolves with a high-pitched glass chime.

panels.shot: frozen rain outside resuming its normal fall
panels.action: Outside the temple, suspended rain droplets resume falling naturally; time returns to normal flow.

panels.shot: the hourglass of eternal abyss descending toward ha-jun
panels.action: The 3-foot diamond-and-obsidian Hourglass levitates from its pedestal, floating gently toward Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: ha-jun hands touching the tenth and final relic
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers touch the glass of the Hourglass of Eternal Abyss: all ten Relics now assembled.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Daso Relics... Pehli baar hazaaron saalo mein ek hi haath mein hain.
